quote: I am consistently hearing from middle income people, especially those on fixed incomes, that property taxes are a real challenge. I'm hearing from businesses that they can't retain employees because the employees can't afford housing. I'm hearing from renters that they are priced out of the market. At the lowest end of the socioeconomic spectrum, we see this in the increasing degree of homelessness,
I can say that as somebody who's developed housing for Habitat for Humanity, they want to get permits,

They understand that, you know, we have a lot of challenges, a lot of needs, especially in the area of infrastructure, and they don't expect miracles, but when projects are going on and say there are delays or there's a really serious pothole that is an absolute hazard, that these things are addressed, that when people reach out asking for help, that they get responses, that they don't make repeated calls or feel like they're being not listened to, even deflected,
I see this as a good move for the community,
